main_text.l: Imperium hodiè in Tartarorum po-testate sit, quorum Imperator, nomine Xunchi, novam regum familiam, Taicing dictam, condidit.
Sclavonica est vel Dalmatica vel Sarmatica.
Inter amplissimas Orbis nationes Sclavi recensentur, quorum lingua hodieq; latissimè obtinet. Hæ Sclavorum gentes circa A. C. 584 se-dibus suis egressæ florentissima regna & Imperia condidere.
Regnum Dalmatiæ Croatiam, Serviam, Russiam, Bosniam & Bulgariam complectebatur. Ex-

page.notes: The page number is printed as "8o", which most likely stands for 80. The "f"-like letters are long s and are transcribed as s (for example "Russiam" as Russiam, "fedibus" as sedibus, "teftate" as testate). The catchword "Ex-" is repeated at the end of the paragraph, so it appears in the text as well. Its position is at the bottom right, so it is also the catchword.
